svg.title: Cost per million invocations by span size
svg.desc: Cost per million hello invocations as each invocation emits more gzipped spans, without fixed charges. logs-destination adds 0.02 dollars of Kinesis PUT units per million and its 13.14-dollar monthly shard. event-bus becomes cheaper than the CloudWatch Logs transports from about 1 KB of gzipped spans per invocation at 256 MB and 2.4 KB at 1,024 MB.
